name: eidola
description: An Engram's scene that reacts to what Claude is doing, in a pane or the band above the prompt.

pane.title: Pane
pane.description: The awake Engram draws in the pane, when it shows there, and the pane opens by itself. Off: the pane opens only when you ask (/eidola).

band.title: Band
band.description: The awake Engram draws in the band above the prompt, when it shows there.

hideBandWhilePaneOpen.title: Hide the band while the pane is open
hideBandWhilePaneOpen.description: The band steps aside while the Eidola pane is open, so an Engram that shows in the pane draws once. A band-only Engram, like the Wisp, keeps its band.

statusLine.title: Show the Vessel's state in the status line
statusLine.description: The Engram's name and state, such as "Wisp · idle", under the prompt.
